name: Onee-san ☆ Hara Mix
source:
"Die within a week...?" The main character is suddenly told so by the grim reaper girl. He will need to make someone pregnant to live longer!? Having sex with a widow and make her pregnant within a week!

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
「一周内会死……？」主人公突然被死神少女如此告知。为了活得更久，他必须让某人怀孕！？在一周内与寡妇做爱并让她怀孕！

[摘自Erogeshop]
